pos.personaBrief: El Gráfico 1978: the ball was the engine of the team and cut risk in its own goal; opponents were allowed few passes. Menotti's 4-3-3 sought dominance through possession, not counter-attack.

pro.personaBrief: FIFA lists circulation, quick passes and density as his pillars, with sudden verticalisations; 'direct 4-3-3' with runners like Kempes and Luque. Technical, short build-up mixed with quick forward play.

est.personaBrief: A simple 4-3-3 with defined roles (cinco, ida y vuelta eight, wide forwards), but fluid, close combinations and mobility were his stated goal (2 Oct 1974 quote).

lar.personaBrief: 1978 attack had Bertoni and Ortiz very wide and Luque central, with Houseman picando por las puntas; full-backs mostly held back (1973 interview).

blo.personaBrief: The 1978 team stood very high, pressed and squeezed constantly, used the offside trap and led the World Cup in recoveries; no low block.

mar.personaBrief: Menotti said his team marked en zona like Brazil, and recovered the ball by collective occupation of space; he rejected the man-marking school.

pla.personaBrief: He cared about perfecting his own fundamentals, opponent only interesting, and insisted on the same attacking intent even in the final; he imposed his idea.

res.personaBrief: Wanted to win by playing well and beating rivals footballistically, disdaining 1-0 from a free kick; though he won the 1978 title, style was central to his identity.

sis.personaBrief: Gave talent 100 percent importance and chose technically gifted players, but demanded intensity, collective recovery and exact application of instructions.

jog.personaBrief: Technique over all: talent 100 percent, technical midfield with Ardiles, a cinco who recovers and distributes; he also demanded intensity and physical preparation against Europeans.

bas.personaBrief: He built the national team through youth squads and interior talent (Toulon 1975), but cut Maradona for experience and relied on veterans in 1978.

lid.personaBrief: Rejected imposed discipline as military, wanted shared convictions and honest players, but decided the plan himself and cut Maradona without explanation, denied Gatti leave.
